Pandora Raven — Album 6.5: The Raven's Shadow

The Raven's Shadow

"The shadow of the raven at the break of dawn is the closest thing to light from where I stand."

[Verse 1] Something warm where there was only cold A flicker in the dark I thought was gone My hands have been so hollow for so long And then — a thread of light along the stone

I did not reach for it, it reached for me Like something that had always known the way And for the first time since they took my voice I felt what I was born to do — not just obey

[Pre-Chorus] And through the thread I felt her On the other side of all this dark Something fractures in the west Something breaking in her chest

[Chorus] So I called the only thing I had The one dark gift that still belonged to me I sent the raven into all that cold And I sent it carrying everything I could not speak Fly West — find her Tell her in the only way I can The shadow of the raven at the break of dawn Is the closest thing to light from where I stand

[Verse 2] The bird sat still and looked at me a moment As if deciding whether I was worth the trust I held my breath — it lifted without question And I watched it disappear into the dusk

I do not know if she will understand I do not know if she will say my name But I have lived four wars on the wrong side of everything And this is me trying to begin again

[Pre-Chorus] She cannot know I’m watching She cannot know I’m near But the raven knows the road back And the raven will stay there

[Chorus] So I called the only thing I had The one dark gift that still belonged to me I sent the raven into all that cold And I sent it carrying everything I could not speak Fly West — find her Tell her in the only way I can The shadow of the raven at the break of dawn Is the closest thing to light from where I stand

[Bridge] A raven does not only carry messages It knows the roads that others cannot see It stays beside the ones that need a witness Until they find the way to where they need to be

I gave the bird one task and then another A third I did not know I gave until now Stay close to her — stay close to what she’s losing The ones she cannot keep — I’ll guide them out somehow

[Final Chorus - key lift] I sent the raven carrying everything The guilt, the grace, the first thing light can do The shadow of the raven falls at dawn And if she looks up — tell her it was you Tell her — I am here Tell her — I am coming Tell her — the dark I was is not all I am The shadow of the raven is the only light I have

[Outro] She whispered something I felt it through the cold She said a name — my name — and that was all And I held on to that the way you hold A thread of warm against a northern wall
